subject.title: fix: stabilize embedded prompt caching across policy and Responses boundaries

question: Should non-owner and ambient turns receive the four protected core-tool schemas when every call is denied by the immutable current-turn policy before hooks and side effects?
rationale: The patch intentionally trades prior inventory hiding for prompt-cache stability; automated tests can prove enforcement but cannot choose whether schema visibility is an acceptable security and product boundary.

options.title: Accept Visible Schemas
options.body: Keep the stable catalogue, require immutable pre-side-effect denial and exact-head live proof, and document this as the intended boundary.

options.title: Preserve Hidden Inventory
options.body: Keep unauthorized protected tools absent and redesign cache stability without changing the existing visibility boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept Visible Schemas
recommendation.body: Keep the stable catalogue, require immutable pre-side-effect denial and exact-head live proof, and document this as the intended boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history spans the central agent, provider, and Codex paths involved in this boundary.
